title: Budget-Priced “Full/Queen” Comforter Doesn't Really Fit Queen Bed
text:
Budget-Priced “Full/Queen” Comforter Doesn't Really Fit Queen Bed. This SWEET HOME COLLECTION MICROFIBER DOWN ALTERNATIVE COMFORTER SET WITH PILLOW SHAMS (Full/Queen, Reversible Burgundy/Black) is a nice budget-priced (about $33 on Amazon) everyday comforter. It's a 100% microfiber “down alternative” comforter. That means no feathers, so it's good for those with asthma or allergies. The microfiber fabric looks and feels like ordinary cotton.

The comforter just covers the top of my Queen bed lengthwise; on each side there is a 6-inch overhang. The comforter comes nowhere near reaching to the floor at the foot and sides, as shown in the product page photo. I haven't washed my comforter yet, so I don't know whether it will shrink, or whether the microfiber fill will shift, when the comforter is machine washed for the first time.

The pillow shams are Queen-sized pillowslips made from the same fabric as the comforter. One side of the pillowslip is dark red (burgundy), one side is black. The stitching is kind of coarse, with some hanging threads. The colors in the product page photo are accurate.

This "Full/Queen" comforter is sized to go underneath a Queen bedspread (for warmth), not to serve as a decorative bed topper.
